userStories.title: Create Unit API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to create a new Unit (e.g., 'm2', 'kg') so that it can be used in product definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate code is unique in the database.
Follow Clean Architecture: Domain Entity, Repository Interface, Use Case, Infrastructure Repository, and Presentation Controller.

userStories.title: List Units API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to list all available Units.
acceptanceCriteria: Return an array of Unit objects.

userStories.title: Get Unit by Code API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to retrieve details of a specific Unit by its code.
acceptanceCriteria: Return Unit object or 404 if not found.

userStories.title: Delete Unit API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to delete a Unit that is no longer needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Block deletion if the Unit is referenced by any Product or UnitConversion (Foreign Key constraint).

userStories.title: Create Category API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to create a new Product Category with a manual code.
acceptanceCriteria: DTO includes code (unique, required) and name (required).

userStories.title: Update Category API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to update an existing Category's name or code.
acceptanceCriteria: Allow updating code (with uniqueness check) and name.

userStories.title: List Categories API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to list all product categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Support basic pagination/sorting if applicable (optional for MVP).

userStories.title: Get Category by ID API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to retrieve a specific category by its ID.

userStories.title: Delete Category API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to delete a category.
acceptanceCriteria: Block deletion if Category has associated Products.

userStories.title: Create Product API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to create a new Product with manual code and physical metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: DTO includes code (unique), name, categoryId, baseUnit, basePrice (string for decimal), length, width, height.
Ensure Decimal fields are handled correctly (stored as NUMERIC(15,3)).

userStories.title: Update Product API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to update product details.
acceptanceCriteria: Allow updating all fields (code, name, metrics, etc.).

userStories.title: List Products API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to list all products.
acceptanceCriteria: Include Category name and Unit code in response (Join/Include).

userStories.title: Get Product by ID API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to retrieve details of a specific product.
acceptanceCriteria: Return Product object with relations or 404.

userStories.title: Delete Product API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to delete a product.
acceptanceCriteria: Block deletion if Product has Inventory or Transaction history.

userStories.title: Create Unit Conversion API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to define a conversion rule between units for a product.
acceptanceCriteria: DTO includes productId, fromUnit, toUnit, factor (string for decimal).
Validate productId, fromUnit, and toUnit exist.

userStories.title: Update Unit Conversion API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to update an existing conversion rule.

userStories.title: List Unit Conversions API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to list all unit conversion rules.

userStories.title: Get Unit Conversion by ID API
userStories.description: As a User, I want to retrieve a specific conversion rule.

userStories.title: Delete Unit Conversion API
userStories.description: As an Admin, I want to delete a conversion rule.
